product_overview: Inventory PPE is an internal Laravel Blade web application for managing PPE inventory, personnel readiness, mobilization/demobilization, warehouse transfers, material requests, and inter-warehouse PPE lending. Access is role-based and scoped by gudang (warehouse) session, with all actions presented as HTML pages and form submissions rather than JSON APIs.
core_goals: Maintain accurate PPE stock per warehouse, including item variants and min-max attention levels.
Support role-based warehouse access so users only operate within assigned gudang.
Track personnel, PPE usage, mobilization, and demobilization status across warehouses.
Manage material requests, incoming/outgoing PPE journals, transfers, and inter-warehouse borrowing.
Allow SuperAdmin to manage accounts, roles, and master data synchronization.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users sign in with email/password or Google OAuth. Public registration is disabled, and authenticated sessions are required for all protected pages.
user_flows: GET /login to open the login form -> Receive 200 HTML with CSRF token -> POST /login with valid email, password, and _token -> Receive 302 redirect to /home -> GET /home with session -> Receive warehouse list
GET /login to open the login form -> Receive 200 HTML with CSRF token -> POST /login with invalid credentials -> Receive 200 HTML or redirected login state with validation error message
GET /register as a public visitor -> Receive 404 because self-registration is disabled
GET /auth/google to start Google OAuth login -> Receive redirect to Google sign-in flow -> Complete callback flow at /auth/google/callback -> Receive authenticated session and redirect to /home

features.name: Gudang Access
features.description: After login, users choose an authorized warehouse and enter the application context for that gudang. Unauthorized warehouse access is redirected back to the warehouse list.
user_flows: GET /home after login -> Receive 200 HTML list of gudang with access flags -> GET /gudang/1/masuk for an authorized gudang -> Receive redirect to /dashboard with gudang session set -> GET /dashboard -> Receive 200 HTML dashboard for gudang 1

GET /home after login -> Receive 200 HTML list of gudang -> GET /gudang/2/masuk for an unauthorized gudang -> Receive 302 redirect to /home with access error -> Remaining session stays on the allowed gudang or no gudang context
GET /dashboard without an active gudang session -> Receive 302 redirect to /home -> User is prompted to select a warehouse first

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: The dashboard shows the active warehouse summary, alerts, and dismissible notifications tied to the current user and gudang context.
user_flows: GET /dashboard with an active gudang session -> Receive 200 HTML dashboard with summary cards and alerts -> POST /dashboard/notifikasi/dismiss with valid CSRF token -> Receive 302 redirect back to dashboard and the notification no longer appears for that user
GET /dashboard without a gudang session -> Receive 302 redirect to /home -> No dashboard content is shown
GET /dashboard as a user without access to the active gudang -> Receive 302 redirect to /home with an access error and the gudang context is cleared

features.name: Master Sync
features.description: SuperAdmin can synchronize master data such as warehouses, personnel, positions, items, and position equipment from upstream sources into local storage.
user_flows: GET /master-sync as SuperAdmin -> Receive 200 HTML sync page -> POST /master-sync with valid CSRF token and selected endpoint(s) -> Receive 302 or 200 result with success message such as sync berhasil -> Local master data is refreshed
GET /master-sync as non-SuperAdmin -> Receive 302 redirect to /home -> Sync page is not accessible
POST /master-sync with an upstream failure or partial failure -> Receive response indicating sebagian data gagal di-sync -> Existing local data remains available and is not cleared

features.name: User Management
features.description: SuperAdmin manages user accounts, roles, activation status, and warehouse assignments.
user_flows: GET /users as SuperAdmin -> Receive 200 HTML user list -> POST /users with CSRF token, name, email, role, active flag, and gudang access -> Receive 302 redirect with success message that the account was added
PUT /users/{user} as SuperAdmin with valid CSRF token -> Receive 302 redirect with updated role or warehouse assignment saved -> GET /users reflects the changes
DELETE /users/{user} as SuperAdmin with valid CSRF token -> Receive 302 redirect and user is removed
GET /users as AdminPPE or any non-SuperAdmin role -> Receive 302 redirect to /home -> User list is not accessible
PUT /users/{user} attempting to lower or disable the current SuperAdmin account -> Receive validation error or blocked update -> Self-demotion and self-deactivation are prevented

features.name: Data Stok
features.description: Users with permission can view, create, update, and delete stock items for the active gudang. Stock is tracked per warehouse and item variant, with min-max attention indicators.
user_flows: GET /gudang/1/stok with a permitted role and active gudang session -> Receive 200 HTML stock list -> POST /gudang/1/stok with CSRF token, item, variant, quantity, and category -> Receive 302 redirect with success message and the new stock appears in the list
PUT /gudang/1/stok/{id} with valid CSRF token and permitted role -> Receive 302 redirect with success message that stock was updated -> GET /gudang/1/stok shows the new quantity or Min percentage
DELETE /gudang/1/stok/{id} with valid CSRF token and permitted role -> Receive 302 redirect with success message that stock was deleted

POST /gudang/1/stok with a duplicate item already present in the warehouse -> Receive validation error stating the item already exists in stock and quantity changes must use Material Request or update flow
GET /gudang/1/stok as Manager or HSE Officer -> Receive 200 HTML view-only list without add/edit/delete controls -> Attempting POST/PUT/DELETE on the same route redirects to /home with no permission

features.name: Transfer Barang
features.description: Authorized users can transfer stock from a source gudang to the configured destination gudang, creating matching outgoing and incoming journal entries.
user_flows: GET /gudang/1/transfer-barang from a non-destination warehouse -> Receive 200 HTML transfer form -> POST /gudang/1/transfer-barang with CSRF token, valid item list, quantities, and destination warehouse -> Receive 302 redirect with success message that transfer to the destination gudang succeeded
GET /gudang/target/transfer-barang as the configured destination gudang -> Receive 200 HTML that indicates the warehouse is the destination, not the sender

POST /gudang/target/transfer-barang from the configured destination gudang as the sending source -> Receive validation error stating transfer can only be performed from other gudang to the destination warehouse
POST /gudang/1/transfer-barang with quantity greater than available stock -> Receive error message indicating insufficient stock and the transfer is not processed

features.name: Data Personel
features.description: Users manage personnel assigned to the active gudang, including positions and Onsite/Offsite status synced across warehouses.
user_flows: GET /gudang/1/personel with a permitted role -> Receive 200 HTML personnel list -> POST /gudang/1/personel with CSRF token, selected master personel, and positions -> Receive 302 redirect with success and the person appears in the gudang list
PUT /gudang/1/personel/{id} with valid CSRF token -> Receive 302 redirect and the personnel assignment is updated
DELETE /gudang/1/personel/{id} with valid CSRF token -> Receive 302 redirect and the personnel is removed from the gudang assignment list
POST /gudang/1/personel with a person already registered in that gudang -> Receive validation error that the person is already registered and cannot be added again
GET /gudang/1/personel as HSE Officer or Manager -> Receive 200 HTML read-only personnel list -> POST/PUT/DELETE redirects to /home because those roles are view-only

features.name: PPE Masuk Keluar
features.description: Users can view inbound and outbound PPE journals for the active gudang; these pages are read-only and reflect MR arrivals, transfers, mobilization, demobilization, and approved spare usage.
user_flows: GET /gudang/1/ppe-masuk with an active gudang session -> Receive 200 HTML list of inbound PPE records with item, quantity, date, and reference number
GET /gudang/1/ppe-keluar with an active gudang session -> Receive 200 HTML list of outbound PPE records with item, quantity, date, and source reference
GET /gudang/1/ppe-masuk or /gudang/1/ppe-keluar as any authorized view role -> Receive 200 HTML, with no create/update/delete actions available
GET /gudang/2/ppe-masuk without access to gudang 2 -> Receive 302 redirect to /home with access denied context

features.name: Pemakaian PPE
features.description: All roles can review PPE usage per personel, including a matrix of non-consumable items and detailed usage history.
user_flows: GET /gudang/1/pemakaian-ppe with an active gudang session -> Receive 200 HTML matrix of personel versus non-consumable PPE usage
GET /gudang/1/pemakaian-ppe/{personelId} -> Receive 200 HTML detail page with item-level usage history for the selected personel
GET /gudang/1/pemakaian-ppe/{personelId} for a valid personel that has no usage records -> Receive 200 HTML detail view showing empty or zero-usage state
GET /gudang/2/pemakaian-ppe as a user without access to gudang 2 -> Receive 302 redirect to /home

features.name: Permintaan PPE
features.description: Users create, manage, export, and track Material Requests (MR), including item arrival progress and PDF output. AdminPPE and SuperAdmin can also create request tables for printing.
user_flows: GET /gudang/1/permintaan/buat-tabel as SuperAdmin or AdminPPE -> Receive 200 HTML request-table form -> POST /gudang/1/permintaan/buat-tabel/export with CSRF token and request data -> Receive file download or rendered export output for the template

GET /gudang/1/permintaan as a permitted role -> Receive 200 HTML request list -> POST /gudang/1/permintaan with CSRF token, MR number, date, and at least one stock item -> Receive 302 redirect with success message that the Material Request was created
GET /gudang/1/permintaan/{id} -> Receive 200 HTML request detail page -> GET /gudang/1/permintaan/{id}/pdf -> Receive PDF download for the request

PUT /gudang/1/permintaan/{id} with valid CSRF token -> Receive 302 redirect with success message that the MR number was updated -> DELETE /gudang/1/permintaan/{id} -> Receive 302 redirect with success message that the request was deleted
POST /gudang/1/permintaan/{permintaanId}/item/{itemId}/kedatangan with qty greater than remaining balance -> Receive validation error stating arrival quantity exceeds the remaining amount
GET or POST create/update/delete actions on /gudang/1/permintaan as HSE Officer or Manager -> Receive 200 for view pages only, and 302 redirect to /home or denial for write actions

features.name: Mobilisasi
features.description: Mobilization plans allocate PPE, validate completeness per personel, and move the project from draft to running state.
user_flows: GET /gudang/1/mobilisasi as an authorized role -> Receive 200 HTML list of draft and running mobilizations -> GET /gudang/1/mobilisasi/create -> Receive 200 HTML create form -> POST /gudang/1/mobilisasi with CSRF token, at least one Offsite personel, and optional SR/location -> Receive 302 redirect with draft mobilization created and personel status updated to Onsite

GET /gudang/1/mobilisasi/{id}/pengecekan/{personelId} -> Receive 200 HTML PPE completeness check page -> POST form submission for required items with valid CSRF token -> Receive 302 redirect when completeness is satisfied and the personel can be submitted
POST /gudang/1/mobilisasi/{id}/jalankan with CSRF token after all personel have completed checks -> Receive 302 redirect and mobilization status changes from draft to running
DELETE /gudang/1/mobilisasi/{id} for a draft mobilization -> Receive 302 redirect and the draft is removed -> Personel are returned to Offsite if they have no other active mobilization
POST /gudang/1/mobilisasi/{id}/jalankan before completeness is finished -> Receive error message that all personel must complete the check first
GET/POST/DELETE on mobilisasi as HSE Officer or Manager -> Receive 200 for view pages only, while create/jalankan/edit actions redirect to /home

features.name: Demobilisasi
features.description: Demobilization records the return of personel, captures item condition checks, and determines whether the mobilization can finish or requires approval.
user_flows: GET /gudang/1/demobilisasi as an authorized role -> Receive 200 HTML list of running and completed mobilizations -> POST /gudang/1/demobilisasi/{id}/selesaikan/{personelId} with CSRF token -> Receive 302 redirect and the personel status becomes belum cek / Offsite with today’s demob date

GET /gudang/1/demobilisasi/{id}/cek-kelengkapan/{personelId} -> Receive 200 HTML check page -> Submit item conditions with valid CSRF token -> Receive 302 redirect and either demob completes immediately or moves to approval if there are damaged/lost items
GET /gudang/1/demobilisasi/{id}/cek-kelengkapan/{personelId} after a check is already submitted -> Receive read-only page state showing the form is no longer editable
POST /gudang/1/demobilisasi/{id}/selesaikan/{personelId} for a personel who must not be re-mobilized yet -> Receive protected behavior that keeps the personel unavailable until demob completion

features.name: Approval Demob
features.description: SuperAdmin and HSE Officer review demobilization exceptions and approve or reject them; they also handle spare usage approvals.
user_flows: GET /gudang/1/approval-demob as SuperAdmin or HSE Officer -> Receive 200 HTML approval list showing personel waiting for approval and problematic items
POST /gudang/1/approval-demob/{personelId}/approve with valid CSRF token -> Receive 302 redirect and demob is finalized with approval timestamp and optional note
POST /gudang/1/approval-demob/{personelId}/reject with valid CSRF token -> Receive 302 redirect and the personel returns to the check stage with previous results cleared
POST /gudang/1/approval-demob/{personelId}/approve or /reject as AdminPPE or Manager -> Receive 302 redirect to /home because the menu is not accessible to those roles

POST spare approval/rejection actions from the same module with valid CSRF token -> Approve reduces spare stock and records PPE Keluar, while reject keeps spare stock unchanged and shows a rejection message

features.name: Peminjaman PPE
features.description: Authorized users can request PPE borrowing between warehouses, with approval performed only by the source gudang and optional return handling.
user_flows: GET /gudang/1/peminjaman-ppe as a permitted role -> Receive 200 HTML borrowing list for requests where the active gudang is source or borrower -> POST /gudang/1/peminjaman-ppe with CSRF token, item from borrower stock, source warehouse, and quantity -> Receive 302 redirect with status pending
GET /gudang/1/peminjaman-ppe as the source warehouse after a pending request exists -> Receive 200 HTML notification or list showing the new borrowing request
POST /gudang/1/peminjaman-ppe/{id}/approve with valid CSRF token from the source warehouse -> Receive 302 redirect and stock moves from source to borrower, changing status to approved
POST /gudang/1/peminjaman-ppe/{id}/reject with valid CSRF token and rejection note -> Receive 302 redirect and status changes to rejected without stock changes
POST /gudang/1/peminjaman-ppe/{id}/approve when source stock is insufficient -> Receive error and the approval does not complete
POST /gudang/1/peminjaman-ppe/{id}/approve or return actions as Manager -> Receive 302 redirect to /home because Manager is view-only for this module
